list.name: evidence
list.label: Evidence
list.query: intersected — agent lines survived : intersected,observed — agent edited the files : observed,inferred — from surrounding evidence : inferred,declared — stated only : declared,undetermined — no evidence either way : undetermined

options.content:
How much of each commit the agent wrote, and how sure the tool is

Attribution has a strength: intersected means agent-written lines were found in the commit itself, observed means the agent edited the files, inferred and declared are weaker. The agent's share of lines is the ratio per commit — known only when the evidence supports it, and left unknown otherwise rather than guessed. This page shows the distribution of that share, where the evidence is strongest, and which repositories the tool has no verdict on.

panels.title: Coverage
panels.description: Share of commits in instrumented repositories that carry an AI-Attribution trailer of any kind, including the states meaning no evidence was available. **Coverage is not adoption** — a repository at 100% may have had no agent involvement at all. It says the instrumentation is working, nothing more.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT w.commit_sha)
                    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.sha), 0), 1) AS coverage
FROM commits c
JOIN repo_commits rc  ON rc.commit_sha  = c.sha
JOIN repo_commits rc2 ON rc2.repo_id    = rc.repo_id
JOIN whodunit_commits seen ON seen.commit_sha = rc2.commit_sha
LEFT JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = c.sha
WHERE c.authored_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom())
                          AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo())

panels.title: Penetration
panels.description: Share of commits with a real verdict that are AI-assisted. The denominator is `assisted` + `unassisted` + `unmatched` — all three mean the tool looked and reached an answer. `uninstrumented` and `undetermined` are excluded: it never looked, so counting them would understate this. Read it beside Coverage.

targets.rawSql:
-- status-set-excludes: undetermined, uninstrumented, degraded
--   the tool never reached a verdict on these, so counting them
--   would understate the rate rather than complete it
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(status = 'assisted')
     / NULLIF(SUM(status IN ('assisted','unassisted','unmatched')), 0) AS penetration
FROM whodunit_commits
WHERE committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.title: Commits
panels.description: Total commits in the selected window, whether or not they carry a trailer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS commits FROM whodunit_commits WHERE committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.title: Median agent share
panels.description: Median ratio across commits that have one. Ratio is the share of a commit's changed lines matching text an agent produced — overlap, not authorship. A line the agent wrote and a developer then edited counts as the developer's. Commits with no line-level evidence are excluded, not counted as zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT AVG(t.ratio) AS median_share FROM (
  SELECT c.ratio,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.ratio) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM whodunit_commits c
  WHERE c.ratio IS NOT NULL
    AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                           AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
) t
WHERE t.rn IN (FLOOR((t.n + 1) / 2), CEIL((t.n + 1) / 2))

panels.title: Evidence mix
panels.description: How much evidence stands behind each commit, strongest first: intersected, observed, declared, inferred — then the states meaning there is none. Read it beside any penetration figure: a number resting on `declared` is a different claim from one resting on `intersected`.

targets.rawSql:
-- status-set-excludes: undetermined
--   the COALESCE fallback already labels it; naming it here
--   would shadow that with the raw status
SELECT CASE
         WHEN c.method <> 'undetermined' THEN c.method
         ELSE COALESCE(c.reason,
              CASE WHEN c.status IN ('uninstrumented','unmatched','unassisted','degraded')
                   THEN c.status END,
              'undetermined')
       END AS state,
       COUNT(*) AS commits
FROM whodunit_commits c
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY CASE
         WHEN c.method <> 'undetermined' THEN c.method
         ELSE COALESCE(c.reason,
              CASE WHEN c.status IN ('uninstrumented','unmatched','unassisted','degraded')
                   THEN c.status END,
              'undetermined')
       END
ORDER BY commits DESC

panels.title: How much of a commit the agent wrote
Agent share of lines, per assisted commit
panels.description: Every assisted commit with a known share, binned by how much of it the agent wrote. A cluster near one is whole commits handed over; a cluster in the middle is collaboration; two humps is two ways of working on one team. The median above is one point on this shape.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.ratio AS `Agent share of lines` FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.ratio IS NOT NULL AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')

panels.title: Assisted commits with a known share, and without
panels.description: How many assisted commits carry a share of lines and how many do not. A share needs line-level evidence; a commit attributed by weaker means has none, and is counted here rather than given a zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(c.ratio IS NOT NULL) AS `With a share`, SUM(c.ratio IS NULL) AS `Share unknown`
FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')

panels.title: Agent share by work type
panels.description: Average agent share of lines per assisted commit, by purpose. Which kinds of work get handed over whole and which stay collaborative. Purposes with under 5 commits are omitted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.purpose AS metric, ROUND(AVG(c.ratio)*100,0) AS value
FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.ratio IS NOT NULL AND c.purpose <> '' AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
GROUP BY c.purpose HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Where the evidence is strong, and where there is none
Evidence strength by agent
panels.description: Assisted commits per agent, split by how they were attributed. Agents differ in what they record, so the strongest tier is not equally available to all — an agent that never reaches intersected is one whose transcript does not carry line hashes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.agent AS metric,
       SUM(c.method='intersected') AS `intersected`, SUM(c.method='observed') AS `observed`,
       SUM(c.method='inferred') AS `inferred`, SUM(c.method='declared') AS `declared`
FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status='assisted' AND c.agent <> '' AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}') GROUP BY c.agent ORDER BY SUM(1) DESC

panels.title: Evidence by repository
panels.description: Per repository: assisted share, how much of that assisted work reached the strongest tier, and the share of commits the tool gave no verdict on. A high no-verdict share is a repository where the tool is not installed or not reaching the transcripts.

targets.rawSql:
-- status-set-excludes: unassisted, unmatched
--   both are verdicts the tool reached; this column counts the commits
--   it reached none on, so they belong on the other side by design

WITH c AS (SELECT c.* FROM whodunit_commits c WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')),
nm AS (SELECT c.repo_id, MAX(rp.name) name FROM c JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.commit_sha JOIN repos rp ON rp.id = rc.repo_id GROUP BY c.repo_id)
SELECT COALESCE(nm.name, LEFT(c.repo_id,8)) AS `Repository`, COUNT(*) AS `Commits`,
       ROUND(100*SUM(c.status='assisted')/COUNT(*),0) AS `Assisted %`,
       ROUND(100*SUM(c.method='intersected')/NULLIF(SUM(c.status='assisted'),0),0) AS `Intersected, of assisted %`,
       ROUND(100*SUM(c.status IN ('undetermined','uninstrumented','degraded'))/COUNT(*),0) AS `No verdict %`
FROM c LEFT JOIN nm ON nm.repo_id = c.repo_id GROUP BY c.repo_id, nm.name ORDER BY `Commits` DESC

panels.title: Evidence mix over time
panels.description: Commits per day by evidence state. A drop in the stronger states without a drop in commit volume usually means an adapter stopped recognising its agent's format, not that people stopped using agents.

targets.rawSql:
-- status-set-excludes: undetermined
--   the COALESCE fallback already labels it; naming it here
--   would shadow that with the raw status
SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(c.committed_at / 1000000000 / 86400) * 86400) AS time,
       CASE
         WHEN c.method <> 'undetermined' THEN c.method
         ELSE COALESCE(c.reason,
              CASE WHEN c.status IN ('uninstrumented','unmatched','unassisted','degraded')
                   THEN c.status END,
              'undetermined')
       END AS metric,
       COUNT(*) AS value
FROM whodunit_commits c
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY time, CASE
         WHEN c.method <> 'undetermined' THEN c.method
         ELSE COALESCE(c.reason,
              CASE WHEN c.status IN ('uninstrumented','unmatched','unassisted','degraded')
                   THEN c.status END,
              'undetermined')
       END
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Most agent-edited files
panels.description: Per-file agent activity, from observed edits rather than commits. A file with many edits and few committed lines is one the agent iterated on heavily — that is effort, not output.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(file, '/', -1) AS file, COUNT(*) AS agent_edits, SUM(lines_added) AS lines_written FROM whodunit_events WHERE file <> '' AND observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 GROUP BY file ORDER BY agent_edits DESC LIMIT 20

options.content: Read with care. A commit with no share is not a commit with zero agent involvement; it is one where the evidence did not support a number, and it is counted separately. No verdict means undetermined, uninstrumented or degraded — the tool was absent or could not decide — and is never folded into unassisted. Evidence strength differs by agent because agents differ in what they record, not in how honest they are.
